title: Six Eyes
content: The Six Eyes are an innate gift rarely inherited within the Gojo Clan. They are a nonstandard jujutsu trait manifesting as a pair of bright blue eyes that grant a bearer extrasensory perception.

title: Shibuya Incident
content: The Shibuya Incident was a major jujutsu terrorist attack orchestrated by Kenjaku that took place in Shibuya on October 31, 2018. Executed with the goal of sealing Satoru Gojo inside Prison Realm, the conflict spans several stages and encompasses numerous battles to decide the future of Japan.
